Men

Equip | Serve | Connect

The Forest Baptist Church Men’s Ministry is dedicated to equipping the men of FBC to grow in the grace and knowledge of Jesus Christ, to serve the church and community with their gifts, connect in fellowship with one another and their sons, and connect the Good News of Christ to the unchurched.

Bi-Monthly Gatherings

The Men’s Ministry gathers every other month for food, fellowship, and time in God’s Word. We usually have some book giveaways, too. Gatherings are planned for January, March, May, July, September, and November.

Study Groups

Grow in God’s Word and in fellowship with other men. Pursue Christ in the context of relationship with like-minded disciples. The Men’s Ministry offers both morning and evening gatherings of small groups of men who study the bible, read good books, memorize Scripture, pray for one another, and walk in bonds of brotherly love.

Service Projects

The Men’s Ministry has volunteers who from time to time may be available to assist FBC widows and other hardship needs in the church with small repair or maintenance projects.

A.M.
Men's Study

Bi-weekly - Wednesdays at 6:30am at the church building. Contact the church office for more information.

P.M.
Men's Study

Weekly - Thursdays at 6:30pm at the church building. Contact the church office for more information.

For questions or more information about our men's ministry, email info@forestbaptistchurch.org
